region.ui:description: AWS region the VM would run in.

name.ui:description: 3-40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.

data_disk_size_gb.ui:description: 0 for no data disk, otherwise 10-2000 GiB. New in revision 2.

allowed_cidrs.ui:description: Ranges allowed to reach the VM on port 443. **Adding 0.0.0.0/0 makes the VM public.**
